terms.definition: Different fractions that name the same amount, like 1/2 and 2/4.
terms.function: 2/4 and 3/6 both name the same share as 1/2.
terms.whereItIs: The two circles with matching shaded amounts.
terms.whyItMatters: Equivalence lets you rewrite fractions freely to add or compare them.

terms.definition: Multiplying (or dividing) both the numerator and denominator by the same number.
terms.whereItIs: The scale control on the circles.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the mechanism that creates every equivalent fraction.

terms.definition: Dividing a fraction's top and bottom by a common factor until they share only the factor 1.
terms.whereItIs: The simplify control on the right circle.
terms.whyItMatters: Simplest form is the cleanest, easiest-to-read version of a fraction.

terms.definition: Multiplying diagonally across a fraction pair to test equality.
terms.whereItIs: The check the app runs whenever two circles are compared.
terms.whyItMatters: It gives a quick, reliable test for equivalent fractions.

terms.definition: A shared denominator two fractions are rewritten into for comparison or addition.
terms.whereItIs: Produced by scaling with the scale rule.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets fractions with different part sizes be combined.
